notes.title: Version 1.5 is ready to download!
Version 1.1.1 is up and ready!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27812989/b1e78282e92f1c23a104154a859dbb6015b857e5.png

Presenting - The Lectern
But why should you be excited as much as we are?

Now you are able to easily distinguish notes.
Learn where notes should be on the staff.
No vertical lines - no pressure in playing. Find you own rythm and do your best!

Our dev team is giving its best to enhance the game and we hope that you will enjoy the changes! If you want to take part in making Seabed Prelude better, please visit our Community Hub and share your thoughts!

Sincerely
Seabed Prelude Dev Team

notes.title: Version 1.1.0 Released!
Version 1.0.2 Released
Version 1.0.1 Released
Pre-release party in DiscoVR
notes.notes:
Today we had a pleasure to present Seabed Prelude during pre-release party in DiscoVR. During the event our friends and press had the opportunity to take the first peek on our new educational title. 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27812989/8cc45f7cd2feff2f088f4a436c3c25b9fd4d61bb.jpg

Are you ready to immerse into post-apocalyptic world and discover the secret behind the Constructors conspiracy? Seabed Prelude is becoming available tomorrow on Steam for both HTC Vive and Oculus.
